linked_h_summaries.realization_pattern: Navigate to an available open horizontal surface; inspect contents; acquire target if present; otherwise fall back to systematic traversal of remaining receptacles, opening closed ones as needed.
linked_h_summaries.scope: ALFWorld clean-then-place tasks targeting a knife where the entry observation lists multiple open horizontal surfaces and closed storage receptacles, and the target is not immediately visible.
